description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of RetrieveFeaturesStrategy, a component involved in querying features of a Thing entity within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes setup, immutability, and various test scenarios for retrieving features with or without specified fields, as well as handling cases where features are absent.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesStrategyTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for Verify the correctness and behavior of RetrieveFeaturesStrategy component.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the RetrieveFeaturesStrategy instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that RetrieveFeaturesStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: retrieveFeaturesWithoutSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieving features without specifying particular fields.

methods.name: retrieveFeaturesWithSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieving features with specific selected fields.

methods.name: retrieveFeaturesFromThingWithoutFeatures
methods.description: Ensures proper exception handling when features are missing from the Thing.
